title: Gideon and the Witness
author: Kestrel Brightwater
blurb: Sebastian Dravenmoor, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
